kernel.governing_law: Abundance is effortless and everywhere — intoxication, wit, and velocity cost nothing, flow freely like found goods, and the only economy is overflow.
kernel.mutated_relation: Every free thing was paid for — the effortlessness is debt, the overflow is depletion, the velocity is what was burned to move.

independent.recovered_law: TEXT B replaces the original vocabulary across all domains (street slang, physical actions, sensory imagery) with financial/debt terminology, systematically reframing every element as a creditor-debtor relationship. The casual, playful agency of the speaker acquiring and consuming things becomes a structured financial obligation where every action is recast as borrowing, defaulting, or owing.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: free/effortless elements systematically recast as debt/financial obligations, with every action reframed as having a hidden cost or creditor-debtor relationship.
independent.terminal_note: The financial/debt metaphor is maintained consistently through the final lines, with 'debtors,' 'leveraged,' 'subprime,' 'margin call,' and 'collection drum' all sustaining the changed relational framework.
